The same flag also gates post-draw refraction cleanup. The setter performs no local validation or graphics calls.

facts.value: Applies the terminal Fighter-state update for a visual command used by fighter color animations. In the Spy Cloak presentation, the first stored operand controls whether material setup takes the refractive rendering path, and the paired byte selects an entry in that path's refraction texture list. This changes presentation state, not the cloak duration or shared refraction user count; the field name x2134_vibrateFrame does not by itself establish vibration timing.
